title: ScanOut
description: `kipple scan --json`: one envelope once the scan finished.

by_command_line_processes.description:
How many of the current user's processes couldn't be fully inspected and were
checked by their command line only for findings in the home directory that are
otherwise idle (D-052). Absent when none was.

findings.description: Every finding, sorted by lens, rule, then path.

integrations.description: Every integration that ran, sorted by lens, then ID.

level.description:
The global carefulness level (`care.level`). A finding whose rule has its own
carries that in its `level`.

outcome.description: Whether the scan ran to the end.

unchecked_system_processes.description:
How many processes owned by root or `SYSTEM`, or running with root's rights,
couldn't be inspected and weren't counted for findings in the home directory that
are otherwise idle (D-050, D-052).

ActivityOut.description: Whether a running program uses a finding (`docs/04-safety-model.md` §4, D-050).

oneOf.description: Every process that counts was inspected, and none shows it in use.

by_command_line.description:
How many of the current user's processes couldn't be fully inspected and were
checked by their command line only, because it is in the home directory
(D-052). Absent when none was.

unchecked_system.description:
How many processes owned by root or `SYSTEM`, or running with root's rights,
couldn't be inspected and weren't counted, because it is in the home directory.
0 when none was left out.

oneOf.description: A process shows it in use.

path.description:
The path that matched. Nothing else of the process's command line or
environment is ever shown.

seen.description:
How: `executable`, `working-directory`, `argument`, `environment`,
`mapped-file`, or `runtime` (its runtime working in its project).

oneOf.description: Some processes that count couldn't be inspected, so it might be in use.

message.description: What happened. For people; not a stable value.

AdviceOut.description: A native setting or command, shown and never run.

snippets.description: Exact commands or settings to copy.

text.description: What it does and what to watch out for.

BucketOut.description: A bucket of the home screen (`docs/04-safety-model.md` §2a).

oneOf.description: Passes every check at the level.
Eligible, but loses something beyond the level or changed recently.
Blocked, unknown, report-only or advice only.

CompletenessOut.description: How much of an item was measured.

oneOf.description:
Some entries couldn't be read or are on another file system, so the sizes are
lower bounds.
Sizing stopped because the scan was cancelled.

cost.description: How expensive coming back is: `low`, `high` or `unknown`.

loss.description:
What is lost besides the bytes: `cache-warmth`, `rollback-ability`,
`offline-ability`, `history`.

oneOf.description: A file beside it marks a project.
An entry inside it is one its tool writes.
None of the entries its tool writes is inside: its layout is unknown.

activity.description: Whether a running program uses it, once measured.

consequence.description: What removing it costs, once measured, when its integration verified that.

evidence.description: Why the integration thinks it is what the rule says.

level.description:
The carefulness level its bucket is derived at: its rule's own
(`rules.<id>.level`), else the global one.

rule.description: The rule it was found by.

size.description: What removing it would free, once sized.

verdict.description: Its bucket at that level, once measured.

IntegrationOut.description: One integration's part of a scan.

advice.description: Native settings and commands it suggests. kipple never runs them.

omissions.description: What it could not cover. Omissions make a report partial, never anything safe.

oneOf.description: What AI coding agents leave behind.
The operating system and its package managers.

OmissionOut.description: Something a scan couldn't cover, and why.

kind.description: What kind of gap it is.

message.description: What happened, with the upstream error. For people; not a stable value.

path.description: The path it concerns, if any.

root.description: The symbolic root it concerns, if any.

OutcomeOut.description: Whether a scan ran to the end.

oneOf.description: Every integration finished and every finding was sized.
The scan was cancelled; the report holds what was found until then.

PathOut.description: A path: its display form, plus its exact bytes when it isn't valid Unicode.

display.description: The path, with anything that isn't valid Unicode replaced.

raw.description:
Base64 of the exact bytes (Unix) or UTF-16LE code units (Windows), present only
when `display` lost something.

SizeOut.description: What removing an item would free, in bytes.

allocated.description: Allocated storage, where the platform reports it.

skipped_mounts.description:
How many directories inside are on another file system and weren't read, when
incomplete.

unique_reclaim.description: Allocated storage that only this item holds, where the platform reports it.

unreadable.description: How many entries couldn't be read, when incomplete.

VerdictOut.description: A finding's bucket and every reason for it.

reasons.description:
Why it isn't Safe: for Review, what falls short of the level (`recent`, `recovery`,
`loss`, `high-cost`); for Protected, what holds it (`disabled`, `kept`, `excluded`,
`report-only`, `advice`, `unknown-layout`,
`unknown-consequence`, `unknown-git`, `holds-repository`, `in-use`,
`unknown-activity`, `unknown-modified`). Empty when Safe.
